testCases.testCaseDescription: Verify that the Provider plan list API returns a successful response when called with a valid access token.
testCases.testSteps:
1. Open API testing tool or automation environment.
2. Enter API endpoint: https://dxhub-dev-api.innovaturelabs.net/api/v1/plan/providers.
3. Select HTTP method: GET.
4. Set request headers: Authorization: DXHUB <token>; Accept: application/json.
5. Provide authentication token as per test (DXHUB <access_token> in Authorization header when required).
6. Enter request payload: no body
7. Send the API request.
8. Verify HTTP status code and response body against Expected Result.
testCases.preCondition: Valid API access token exists. API service is available.
testCases.expectedResult: The API should return HTTP 200 with Content-Type application/json. The response body should contain a list structure for provider plans (array or paginated object) with expected fields per API contract.
